purpose: Render an accessible, print-friendly QR mark for an opaque consumer-owned value.
accessibility: Expose an SVG image name and description, keep the encoded value visible for human verification, and provide focused native actions.
Keep copy and print status announcements polite; scanning and camera permissions remain outside the Web component.
responsive: Scale the mark within a bounded surface and let opaque values wrap without horizontal overflow.
Wrap copy and print actions at narrow widths while retaining shared touch-target geometry.
motion: Uses canonical Button transitions for copy and print actions.
Does not animate the QR mark and respects prefers-reduced-motion.

api.name: value
api.description: Opaque value encoded into the QR mark; payload meaning stays with the consumer.

api.name: label
api.description: Human-readable resource label shown beside the mark and used as its accessible title.

api.name: description
api.description: Accessible description for the encoded resource.

api.name: displayValue
api.description: Show the encoded value below the mark for human verification.

api.name: printable
api.description: Show the browser print action for the QR surface.

api.name: onCopy
api.description: Optional notification after the copy attempt completes.
